findings.consequence: A final check just below 3600 seconds followed by serialization/flush crossing the bound can exit zero and be accepted by the client.
findings.defect: The final time/output assertion precedes json.dumps and stdout print/flush of completed=True. No later elapsed-time check or nonzero failure covers that tail.
findings.evidence_kind: Static normal completion/control-flow path; no target execution, fixture or timing test.
findings.repair: Add an inclusive post-final-print/flush time check in the existing failure/reraise region. Late success text must remain unadmitted through nonzero remote status; preserve files, no retry and all frozen numerical/scoped caps.
findings.title: Final completion serialization escapes inclusive soft-time admission
